verdict.rationale: HubSpot Marketing Hub is a SaaS product with AI features (campaign agent, AI content generation, personalized email rewriting), so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions any control or policy that keeps customer data out of AI model training. The AI feature descriptions and the MCP server probe are adjacent topics and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
